fields.description: Boxer/save name, space-padded (defaults to IPPO). First 8 bytes of the 12-byte tagged header block.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a944 copies 8 bytes from the name pointer (*param_1) to block offset +0x00 via FUN_08000ccc(iVar5,*param_1,8); FUN_0800aa58(iVar5,0xb) covers bytes 0..10 in the header checksum. Baseline logical bytes 0x00-0x07 read 'IPPO    '.
fields.name: boxer_name

fields.description: First record character at block offset +0x08; ASCII digit ('0' on fresh save, part of the '000' record trio, likely win/draw/loss digits).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a944 copies 3 bytes from the record pointer (param_1[1]) to block offset +0x08 via FUN_08000ccc(*piVar1+8,param_1[1],3); covered by the FUN_0800aa58 header checksum. Baseline logical byte 0x08 is 0x30 ('0').
fields.name: record_digit_0

fields.description: Second record character at block offset +0x09; ASCII digit ('0' on fresh save).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a944 3-byte record copy to block offset +0x08 via FUN_08000ccc(*piVar1+8,param_1[1],3); covered by the FUN_0800aa58 header checksum. Baseline logical byte 0x09 is 0x30 ('0').
fields.name: record_digit_1

fields.description: Third record character at block offset +0x0A; ASCII digit ('0' on fresh save).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a944 3-byte record copy to block offset +0x08 via FUN_08000ccc(*piVar1+8,param_1[1],3); covered by the FUN_0800aa58 header checksum. Baseline logical byte 0x0A is 0x30 ('0').
fields.name: record_digit_2

fields.description: Header check byte: bitwise-NOT of the plain byte sum of block bytes 0x00-0x0A, stored at block offset +0x0B.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a944 stores uVar3=FUN_0800aa58(iVar5,0xb) at *(iVar5+0xb) (via *DAT_0800aa34=iVar5+0xb); FUN_0800aa58 sums param_2 bytes and returns (~sum)&0xFF. Baseline: sum(0x00..0x0A)=0x48, stored 0xB7=(~0x48)&0xFF; gbakit sum8_inv over [0,11) verifies.
fields.name: header_checksum_value

fields.description: Unwritten tail of the 16-byte header allocation (allocator-cleared, always zero in baseline).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800a944 allocates the header block with FUN_08000db4(0x10) but stores only offsets 0x00-0x0B (8 name + 3 record + 1 checksum); offsets 0x0C-0x0F are never written. Baseline logical bytes 0x0C-0x0F are 0x00.
fields.name: header_reserved

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'IPPO' boxer-name magic at start of save (logical rev8 domain)
